summary: Iteration 16 backend testing for 'Buka Shift Kasir' bug fix. Verified: (1) POST /api/shifts/open with clean numeric payload succeeds, (2) auth-driven cashier_id/outlet_id cannot be spoofed by client, (3) duplicate-open returns 400 with detail containing 'aktif', (4) GET /api/shifts/current returns existing open shift, (5) close-then-reopen flow works. All 7 new iter16 tests pass, and full regression across iter10-15 passes (69 passed, 1 skipped as before).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1495 falls back to hardcoded 'outlet-sudirman' when user.outlet_id is None — consider raising 400 instead so seed drift doesn't silently misassign shifts.
server.py backend file is 2115 lines — should be split into routers (shifts, sales, users, etc.) per code review guideline (>700 line threshold).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing kasir account; all created shifts closed at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 bug fix for Buka Shift Kasir verified end-to-end. Backend was unchanged; frontend now sanitizes IDR string → Number and catches errors with toast. Test file test_iteration16_shift_open_bug.py includes idempotent cleanup (close any open shift before/after). Safe to include in future regression runs.
rca of the issue: Root cause was frontend sending IDR-formatted string like 'Rp 500.000' as opening_cash, which failed Pydantic int validation → 422/400. Backend /api/shifts/open always required only {opening_cash, note} (int + str), deriving cashier_id and outlet_id from JWT. Frontend fix: sanitize to Number before POST and wrap in try/catch to show toast. Verified: clean numeric payload succeeds (200), spoofed cashier_id/outlet_id in payload are ignored (JWT wins), duplicate open returns 400 detail 'Shift aktif masih terbuka', close→reopen works.
